profile.summary: I am currently the lead on-shore developer at FuzeMee, a social media app for college campuses. At FuzeMee, I specialize in full stack engineering, architecture, design, and scalability. Prior to my current Position, I was a computer science major in the engineering school at Princeton University. I have been coding since freshman year of high school and am interested in software engineering and machine learning. Over the years, I have created websites, apps,  simulations, and all manner of programs through school, work, and personal projects.

positions.description: As a Software Engineer on the Media and Entertainment team at Amazon, I build infrastructure that supports the vast needs of today's streaming, sports, and news platforms

positions.title: Lead On-Shore Developer
positions.description: I am the lead US developer of FuzeMee, a social media app for college students that has been rapidly expanding across the country. Having raised a successful seed round, FuzeMee seeks to overhaul the online social scene of colleges within the United States. In my current position, I work on full stack engineering, architecture, design, and scalability. Generally, my day to day includes React Native, NodeJS, AWS / AWS Serverless, Amplify, AppSync, and GraphQL.

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description: I am the CTO of Culture Finders, a job matching platform that takes all of the tediousness out of finding employment. My Co-Founder and I were so frustrated with the inefficiencies of modern job matching that we created the idea of Culture Finders, a platform that automatically pairs you with jobs that fit you best. Using a complete profile of you, including your hobbies and preferences, we match you with coworkers we think you will get along amazingly with in an environment that allows you to thrive. If you are interested in a job matching platform that only has you input your information once, does all the work for you, and has your best interest in mind, sign up today at https://www.culturefinders.com/

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description: Developed the IOS and Android apps for IgniteSTEM, and then ran the engineering team the year after. IgniteSTEM is a Princeton based startup focused on bringing a more hands-on approach to stem through education technology and project-based learning.

positions.title: Summer Engineering and Business Intern
positions.description: Worked as both an engineering and business intern at RapidSOS. On the engineering side, independently implemented a client to test and record the accuracy of RapidSOS’s product. The client is currently being used in quality assurance and, since its introduction, has  increased the efficiency of product testing at the company. On the business side, created sales approaches tailored to the needs of specific clients.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: Wrote programs that analyzed data for stem cell research. Learned how to use MatLab and wrote and edited algorithms that automatically sorted the copious amounts of research data. These algorithms drastically reduced the time it took to analyze data. Before the use of the programs, it took several weeks to analyze fifteen cells. In one morning alone, with the help of the programs, fifty cells were analyzed.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: Assisted in investigating why the rhinovirus did not replicate in some airway immune cells.
